instruction: Hang all the mugs on the mug rack.

frames.label: turn 1: Every mug must end up HANGING from one of the mug tree's pegs: the peg through the hole of the mug's handle, and when the fingers open the mug stays up in the air, lying on its side with its handle uppermost and nothing under it. A mug left standing on the table, or set down beside the rack, is worth nothing however close to a peg it is. One mug per peg, and only the pegs sticking out to the left and to the right of the post are used. For each mug: grip it across one side of its rim, on the side away from the handle; in the air turn it until the handle swings up and the hole through the handle faces along the peg; carry it out past the tip of that peg, slide it straight in along the peg, open the fingers, and pull them straight back out of the cup. 0 of 3 hang from a peg so far; this one (mug0) is being reached for, and 2 others still standing on the table. hang mug0 on the lower peg on the left: orient the left gripper and travel above the object
